title: nematanthus lanceolatus
intro: Nematanthus lanceolatus, commonly known as Silver Vines, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Gesneriaceae family. It is known for its air-purifying properties and ability to remove volatile organic compounds from the air. The leaves of the Silver Vine plant have been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress, with health benefits including improved sleep quality and relief from anxiety. The plant's bioactive constituents, including scopoletin and mesembrine, have been found to possess therapeutic actions including sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
